lines.text: Mark felt a hot spot on his heel two miles in.
He told himself he'd deal with it at the top.
By the summit it was a full blister, and every step down hurt.
Stop the moment you feel rubbing.
Take off the boot, dry the skin and cover the spot with tape or a bandage before it breaks.
Now Mark carries a small first-aid kit and stops early.
Save this before your next long hike.
